definitions: The way in which the visual arts and literature depict the world and women from a masculine, heterosexual perspective, presenting women as objects of male pleasure.
The act of depicting women and the world in the visual arts and literature from a masculine, heterosexual perspective, presenting women as objects of male pleasure.
examples: The film was criticized for its pervasive male gaze.
She analyzed the male gaze in advertising.
Feminist critics often discuss the male gaze.
